_about: Companies that collect and resell personal data in bulk to other brokers and people-search sites. Opting out of them first cuts off data that would otherwise be re-scraped into downstream listings. Facts only, in our own words; sources per entry. 'weight' is how much an opt-out here is worth relative to an ordinary people-search site.
